Yesterday I was awarded the first 
U.S. Chamber of Commerce’s “Advocate for American Business” Award during its national Opportunity Bus Tour.

It was especially meaningful to receive it right here in Glen Cove at Standard Bots — the nation’s largest manufacturer of industrial robots.

We need Democrats and Republicans working together to bring down costs, support our small and growing businesses, and make sure American innovation and high wage creation can thrive. That’s how we grow our economy and keep the American Dream alive for working families.

The auto industry and its workers are the backbone of America’s economy. 

As President Trump prepares to meet with the Chinese president, my message to him is clear: we cannot allow China to destroy our domestic auto and manufacturing industries.

Untrained ICE agents did not belong in airports. And they do not belong in polling stations. 

That would be election interference and cannot be permitted.

Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez, 28, was shot by ICE while working as a food delivery driver. 

ICE must be stopped. Their regime of cruelty will continue until they are held accountable.

We need an independent investigation into this shooting immediately.

Bob Garrett has spent more than 44 years making sure the people of New Jersey are taken care of when they need it most. Walking into @HMHNewJersey you can feel the care, the compassion, and the pride Bob built into every corner and in hospitals across our state.  

Beyond everything he's built, Bob has been a great friend to me and to families across our state. He's the kind of person who makes Jersey such a special place to live, work, and raise a family.   

Thank you, Bob, for giving so much of yourself to patients, to doctors, nurses, techs, to health care, and to our state! Enjoy this next chapter!

Due to the Trump administration’s latest sanctions action, students of Iranian nationality or heritage, including U.S. citizens and residents, had their Law School Admission Council (LSAC) accounts suspended at a crucial point in the law school admissions cycle.

Students who want to become lawyers and contribute to upholding justice in this country should not be blocked from pursuing their education simply because of their national origin or heritage. @CongressMin and I are demanding that @LSAC_Official immediately review and restore improperly restricted accounts and explain why U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and others residing in the United States were affected.
